words: okay so the strongest part is the car park. it was night and it looked like an old black and white film, grainy and flickering.
the stairs. i was running up them and they just kept going, floor after floor, and every wall had the same number painted on it — level 4, level 4, level 4.

i was looking for my car at first, but once i started running i wasn't really thinking about where — just up. i knew someone was following me, but every time i turned round there was only a thin grey dog sitting on the ramp, watching.
more like waiting. it was always already there when i looked back, just sitting and watching, not chasing. that almost made it worse.
it looked real enough, just thin and grey, like it belonged in the black and white. plain, not fluffy or anything.
no, not that i remember. it was just sitting there, still, every time.
it made my chest go tight. i wanted to stop and ask it what it wanted, but i couldn't, so i just ran harder.
i didn't know. it felt like it could go on forever, but then eventually i came out on the roof.
it was raining, but the rain was falling upwards, from the ground into the sky. and my car was there, but it was a little wooden rowing boat parked between the lines.
it felt quiet and strange, like a relief. i wasn't out of breath anymore. and the grey dog was already sitting in the boat.
it felt different, more like it belonged there than like it was watching me. i got in without thinking about it.
the roof of the car park filled with water around us, and we floated. that's where i woke up.
i was still me, just seeing it all happen. no reflection or anything to check, but it felt like me.
i don't remember a colour. the whole thing was black and white like the rest, so the water was just moving light and dark, if that makes sense.
i could hear my feet on the concrete, that echo in the stairwell. i don't remember the dog making any sound at all.
only the places and the dog, i think. the boat too, once it was there. no small things i remember holding.
the moment i turned round and saw the dog on the ramp. that image keeps coming back more than the rest.
